Gamma Ramp Blackout GPU LUT
Direct GPU display dimming to pure black without any windows.

Sends hardware standby signals to DDC/CI-compatible monitors and verifies they return to On.

Uses DDC/CI for compatible external monitors and a black HTML overlay for laptop or non-DDC/CI displays.

Uses NirSoft CLI tool to trigger monitor power standby.
